dedupe_keys.name: soilgrids global gridded soil information at 250 m

description: Global maps of soil properties made with machine learning. The ISRIC page says SoilGrids maps fourteen soil properties, such as pH, soil organic carbon, bulk density, coarse fragments and sand content, at 250 m resolution for six standard depth intervals, with pixel-level uncertainty, from soil observations and covariates such as climate, land cover and terrain, and that the maps are publicly available under CC BY 4.0. The page notes that the beta REST API was paused, with other download routes listed. Coverage is global land. Caveats: the API has no uptime guarantee and was down when read, and predictions are uncertain where observations are sparse. For simulation it gives soil texture and properties for crop water models, runoff and flood modelling and geotechnical screening of infrastructure routes. A related catalogue record is the SoilGrids for DSSAT global soil profiles.
